name: Castaway Cay Cookie's BBQ Chargrilled Mahi-Mahi with Jasmine Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Castaway Cay · Cookie's BBQ, Cookie's Too & Serenity Bay BBQ
whyItWorks: Lean chargrilled mahi-mahi filet over steamed white jasmine rice is high-protein and dairy-free once the salsa is held.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the server behind the counter for a plain piece of grilled Mahi-Mahi without the tomato-red-onion-lime salsa or heavy Cajun rub, paired with steamed jasmine rice.
watchOuts: Tomato, raw red onion, and lime salsa on top (ask for fish with no salsa)
